replicate_algorithm: sample 78 supported scenario IDs with replacement
include all state rows for each sampled scenario, preserving multiplicity
sum realized gains over sampled state instances
divide by sampled state-instance count, including abstentions

gain_definition.override: G_s = A_SBS(s,a) for the action frozen by Stage A

primary_endpoint.population: canonical 2862 unique fresh disagreement states from the 78 supported scenarios

success_conditions: lower endpoint of frozen two-sided 95% scenario-clustered percentile bootstrap CI is strictly greater than 0

secondary_diagnostics_descriptive_only: beneficial overrides where G_s > 0 among overrides
harmful overrides where G_s < 0 among overrides
zero-effect overrides where G_s == 0 among overrides
top-1/top-5 scenario contribution to positive aggregate gain

selector_application_rule.stage_a_predictions: immutable predictions frozen before label access
selector_application_rule.threshold: strict gate_score > tau as implemented by frozen selector semantics
